my-coach.title: Learning Coach
my-coach.purpose: Your next-best learning this month, ranked against your role and your target roles, with the reason for every suggestion.

coach-insights.title: Coach insights
coach-insights.purpose: Aggregated acceptance of Learning Coach suggestions. Counts only; groups under 10 people are suppressed.

coach.intro: Next-best learning for your role and your targets. Every suggestion says why it is here. Qualification is not a game: no points, streaks or rankings, and your choices stay private.
coach.noProfileBody: The coach needs a staff profile with a role. Sign in with a staff role card to see your suggestions.
coach.monthPinned: {n} pinned: expiring qualifications and mandatory items first
coach.monthHours: About {n} h of learning in this list
coach.monthKinds: {n} kinds of learning: courses, practice, on-the-job, people and reading
coach.feedIntro: Ranked by how much each item closes the gap to your current role (full weight) and your target roles (0.6). Open "Why this?" on any card to see the reasoning.
coach.feedEmptyBody: Your profile meets your role's requirements. Pick a focus role to plan ahead, or ask the coach about a topic.
coach.savedEmptyBody: Use Save on a suggestion to keep it here. Saving also tells the coach what you find useful.
coach.hiddenEmptyBody: Suggestions you mark as not relevant stay hidden for 90 days and appear here until then.
coach.privacyBody: Your goal, saved items and feedback are visible only to you. HR sees acceptance rates for groups of 10 or more people, never individual choices. Suggestions are computed by a deterministic engine from your own records; no exam items are used.

card.dismissHint: Hide for 90 days and show fewer suggestions like this
card.dismissedToast: Hidden for 90 days. The coach will show fewer suggestions like this.
card.enrolSession: You will be enrolled on {course}, session on {date}. Elective courses may need your manager's approval first.
card.enrolWaitlist: The session on {date} for {course} is full. You will join the waitlist and move up automatically when a seat frees.
card.enrolNoSession: You will request {course}. No session is scheduled yet, so the training team will offer you one.

goal.title: {n} h a week
goal.noneBody: Set a realistic number of learning hours a week if it helps you plan. It is optional.
goal.monthFit: This month's list is about {feed} h; your goal is about {month} h a month.
goal.private: Only you can see your goal.
goal.hoursHint: 0 to 40, in half hours. Leave empty or 0 for no goal.
goal.noStreaks: There are no streaks or reminders that punish a missed week. Training hours are tracked, not maximised.

focus.currentWeight: Your current role counts in full; target roles count at 0.6.
focus.none: No target role yet. Pick up to three focus roles, or shortlist roles in the Career Navigator.
focus.drawerIntro: Pick up to three roles you are working towards. The coach adds their requirements at weight 0.6. Your development plan target and your shortlist are included automatically.
focus.securityNote: Security, safeguards and cyber roles show the career path only, so the coach does not plan gaps for them.

ask.title: Ask the coach
ask.intro: Ask which courses, practice quizzes or training paths cover a topic. Answers come only from the course catalogue, the training paths and the FAQ, with a citation for each entry.
ask.label: Your question
ask.placeholder: For example: which courses cover chemistry for RO?

examples.radiation: Which course covers radiation protection basics?
examples.chemistry: Which courses cover chemistry for RO?

ask.answerCoursesRole: {n} catalogue entries cover this; entries marked "{role}" build competencies that role needs:
ask.none: I could not find a catalogue entry for "{q}". Try other words, or browse the catalogue.
ask.examRefused: The coach never shares exam questions or answers. Use the open practice quizzes to prepare.
ask.footer: Retrieval over the catalogue (BM25), no generated text. Durations and contents are as published in each entry.

reasons.expires: Your {qual} expires in {n} days: requalify before it lapses
reasons.refresher_course: {course} is the continuing training that keeps this qualification current
reasons.refresher_quals: Check the requalification requirements on your qualification card
reasons.must_keep: Mandatory for your role, due {date} (in {n} days)
reasons.must_keep_overdue: Mandatory for your role and overdue since {date}
reasons.waitlist: The session on {date} is full: {n} on the waitlist
reasons.no_session: No session scheduled yet: enrolling asks the training team for one
reasons.keep_sharp: Keeps {skill} sharp: core for your {role} role
reasons.practice_bank: {n} open practice questions, about {min} minutes. Practice bank only, never exam items
reasons.ojt_task: Task on the {standard} for {role}; evaluated by: {evaluator}
reasons.ojt_critical: Critical task: it must be performed without error to qualify
reasons.mentor_target: Mentor works as {role}, one of your target roles
reasons.reading_general: Operating-experience lesson every role can learn from
reasons.feedback_up: Ranked higher because you saved or enrolled on similar suggestions
reasons.feedback_down: Ranked lower because you marked similar suggestions not relevant

insights.intro: How staff respond to Learning Coach suggestions: saved, enrolled and marked not relevant. Counts only, from the coach's feedback records. No names and no individual choices.
insights.ruleBody: Any cell with fewer than {n} people shows "suppressed" instead of a value. Acceptance = (saved + enrolled) / (saved + enrolled + not relevant).
insights.acceptanceSub: Saved or enrolled, out of all feedback
insights.peopleSub: Distinct staff with at least one signal
